description.narrative: The most significant project outcomes are the increased quality and reliability of electricity supply in the states of Goias and Alagoas, especially for the underserved populations, through reduced losses. The Project also has the potential for greater financial integration by supporting the use of green financing instruments in the market, helping to strengthen the availability of diverse sources of financing for players in the sector.

The proposed IFC investment consists of loans of up to, in aggregate, US$325 million consisting of: (i) an IFC A/B loan to Equatorial Alagoas Distribuidora de Energia S.A. ( EQTL AL or the Company), a subsidiary of Equatorial S.A. (Equatorial or the Group), of an amount of US$100 million for IFCs own account and up to $75 million for the account of Participants; and (ii) an IFC A Loan to Equatorial Goias Distribuidora de Energia S.A. ( EQTL GO or the Affiliate), another subsidiary of Equatorial, of an amount of up to US$150 million for IFCs own account (the Project). The proceeds of the senior Green Loan to EQTL AL are for the financing of a portion of the Companys capex program for 2023 to 2026, including its programs for loss reduction, service quality improvement, and capacity expansion (excluding any new transmission or distribution lines) (the Alagoas Loan). The proceeds of the senior Green Loan to EQTL Goias are aligned with those of the Alagoas Loan, for the financing of a portion of the Affiliates capex program for 2025 to 2026, such as acquiring and installing protection and control systems and substation and measuring equipment within the existing footprints.
